title: Name of the Union
body: The Union shall be known as the 'Ontario Public Service Employees Union/Syndicat des employés de la fonction publique de l'Ontario'.

title: Definition of Union
body: Union means 'Ontario Public Service Employees Union/Syndicat des employés de la fonction publique de l'Ontario' and not a subsidiary body.

title: Headquarters Location
body: The Headquarters of the Union shall be located in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

title: Aims and Purposes of the Union
body: Regulate labour relations, bargain collectively, safeguard human rights, organize employees, advance socio-economic interests, ensure equal pay, dismantle anti-Black, anti-Indigenous, and all forms of racism, and defend the right to strike.

title: Jurisdiction and Eligibility
body: Employees of the Ontario Government, Crown emanating agencies, public service, municipalities, school boards, public utilities, social/welfare agencies, and recognized bargaining units are eligible for membership.

title: Becoming a Member
body: An eligible gainfully employed worker becomes a Member by completing and submitting a prescribed membership application form and paying any required initiation or membership fee.

title: Membership in Good Standing
body: A Member remains in good standing if not more than 3 months in arrears in dues, gainfully employed in an OPSEU bargaining unit, and not suspended or expelled.

title: Members on Leave & Dues
body: Members on LTD/WSIB may seek and hold office and be delegates by paying uniform monthly dues up to $5.00 set by the Board. Members on other leaves pay full dues.

title: Layoff Status Rights
body: Members on regular seasonal, short-term, or indefinite layoff remain in good standing for the recall term without dues; permanently laid-off members are not eligible for continuing membership.

title: Grievance Pending Status
body: Dismissed or improperly laid-off members remain in good standing while a grievance is pending. To hold office, they pay uniform monthly dues up to $5.00.

title: Secondments Outside Unit
body: A steward, officer, or trustee seconded or assigned outside any OPSEU bargaining unit cannot carry out Union duties during secondment, but retains other membership rights.

title: Management Position Ineligibility
body: Any Member concurrently holding a management/excluded position outside the unit or with management oversight over an OPSEU member in their local is ineligible to seek or hold Union office.

title: Retired Members Rights
body: Retiring Members can become Retired Members upon paying $10.00 dues. They have voice but no vote at Local meetings and cannot add to Local delegate/rebate counts.

title: Rights of Members in Good Standing
body: Right to representation, dignity/respect, freedom from discrimination/harassment, nomination and holding office, Local participation, agreement ratification voting, and receiving the Constitution.

title: Mandatory Anti-Racism Training
body: Within 60 days of election or appointment to any OPSEU office, the Member must participate in mandatory OPSEU training on dismantling anti-Black racism, anti-Indigenous racism, and all forms of discrimination.

title: Sanctions & Executive Board Authority
body: By 2/3 majority vote, Executive Board may sanction a member for strikebreaking, anti-racism policy breaches, decertification attempts, or serious constitutional violations.

title: Types of Sanctions
body: Sanctions may include expulsion, suspension for a specified term, removal from office, prohibition on seeking office, training programs, or conditions on membership.

title: Procedural Fairness
body: Decisions under Article 7.4 must adhere to procedural fairness, giving reasonable notice and an opportunity to make representations.

title: Shop Steward Responsibilities
body: Distribute information, carry workplace issues to LEC, communicate LEC decisions, enlist member support in campaigns, and investigate/prepare grievances.

title: Shop Steward Rights
body: Right of access to LEC/unit meetings, right to be informed of grievance disposition, and right to high-quality education and training.

title: Merger with Other Unions
body: Requires a majority vote of members in the joining unit and a 2/3 vote of the Executive Board to grant OPSEU membership.

title: Local Labour Council Affiliation
body: Locals may affiliate with local labour councils; OPSEU Head Office reimburses no less than 90% of affiliation costs.

title: Seven Regions Structure
body: Locals are grouped into 7 Regions. Each Region elects 3 members to the Executive Board.

title: Local Autonomy & Purpose
body: Locals encourage member participation, negotiate local agreements, process grievances, control expenditures, and elect delegates to Convention.

title: Types of Crown Locals
body: Single-Unit Local (one ministry/agency at one site), Multi-Unit Local (one ministry/agency at multiple sites), Composite Local (multiple ministries/agencies).

title: Local Bylaws & Default Rules
body: Locals may adopt bylaws by 2/3 vote. If no local bylaws are adopted, Article 29 of the Constitution applies automatically.

title: Annual Convention Requirement
body: Regular Convention is held annually in Ontario at a time and place determined by the Executive Board.

title: Delegate Election Rules
body: Delegates/alternates are elected at general membership meetings by majority vote (or plurality if adopted). Local President is automatically the first delegate.

title: Resolutions Deadline
body: Resolutions and constitutional amendments must be submitted at least 60 calendar days prior to Convention opening.

title: Convention Rules of Order
body: 3-minute speaking limit per delegate; no speaking twice until all have spoken; 2/3 majority required for previous question/closure; governed by Robert's Rules.

title: Executive Board Composition
body: 21 Members elected at Regional meetings every 3 years (3 per Region), plus 7 Equity Board Members appointed by Executive Board upon Board Equity Committee recommendation.

title: Majority Election Threshold
body: Executive Board elections require a secret ballot and a majority vote (>50%). Run-off ballots drop lowest candidate until majority achieved.

title: Oath of Office
body: Mandatory oath to uphold Constitution, dismantle anti-Black and anti-Indigenous racism, and complete required OPSEU training.

title: Election of President and First VP
body: President and First Vice-President/Treasurer are elected separately by delegates from among the 28 Members-elect of the Board.

title: President Vacancy Succession
body: If President office falls vacant, First VP/Treasurer automatically assumes full duties as Acting President until next Convention election.

title: Executive Board Governance Role
body: Governing body when Convention is not in session; upholds Constitution, implements Convention decisions, formulates policy, oversees officers/staff.

title: Executive Board Meeting Frequency
body: Board meets in regular session at least 6 times per year; interval between meetings cannot exceed 3 months.

title: Trusteeship Imposition & 6-Month Review
body: Board may place a subsidiary body under trusteeship by 2/3 vote for up to 6 months if corrupt, incompetent, or violating Constitution.

title: Decertification Campaign Ban
body: Members shall not participate in or support any campaign to decertify or displace OPSEU in any certified bargaining unit.

title: Non-Budgetary Spending Limits
body: Executive Committee may approve unforeseen/non-budgetary expenditures up to $10,000 on a single item, up to $120,000 annual cap.

title: President Duties & Status
body: Chief Executive Officer working full-time; chairs Board, Committee, and Convention; chief spokesperson for the Union.

title: Constitutional Interpretation Authority
body: President has sole authority to interpret the Constitution and Local Bylaws (after consulting Executive Committee). Subject to appeal to Board or Convention.

title: Provincial Women's Committee
body: Composed of 1 woman member from each Region; promotes programs to encourage women's participation and equality awareness.

title: Provincial Human Rights Committee
body: Composed of 1 member from each Region; promotes workplace, community, national, and international human rights awareness.

title: Provincial Young Workers Committee
body: Composed of 1 member from each Region; develops programs to encourage youth participation and understanding of youth issues.

title: Provincial Francophone Committee
body: Composed of 1 member from each Region; promotes programs for Francophones and awareness of Francophone issues.

title: Indigenous Circle
body: Composed of 2 members per Region; selected triennially to promote programs for First Nation, Métis, and Inuit members.

title: Rainbow Alliance arc-en-ciel Committee
body: Composed of 2 members per Region; selected triennially to promote TBLGIAPQQ2S awareness and participation.

title: Coalition of Racialized Workers Committee
body: Composed of 2 members per Region; selected triennially to promote networks and programs for Black and racialized members.

title: Union Dues Level & Notice
body: Dues level set by Board; increases require 2/3 Convention vote after 3 months advance written notice to all Locals.

title: Strike Fund Temporary Levy
body: Following a strike that drops the Strike Fund below $50M, OPSEU may levy a 0.2% temporary dues supplement until the fund reaches $50M.

title: Strike Fund $50M Floor & 5% Transfer
body: Minimum Strike Fund floor set at $50 million (2001 dollars, CPI adjusted); 5% of general revenue transferred monthly to Strike Fund.

title: Ministry and Sector Divisions
body: Includes OPS Ministries, CAAT Academic, CAAT Support, Hospital Health Professionals, and BPS sectors.

title: Area Councils Formation
body: Formed by Locals in a geographic area; requires a minimum of 5 Locals to form or continue.

title: Strike Fund Allowed Uses
body: Strike pay, work stoppage expenses, and interest-free loans to other striking unions (by 2/3 Board vote).

title: Defence Fund Purpose
body: Maintains Defence Fund to defend Members in fundamental union challenge situations requiring legal, lobbying, or political campaigns.

title: Collective Agreement Ratification
body: Local agreements negotiated in Union name; requires approval of President and ratification by majority of voting members before signing.

title: Duty to Report Agreement Breaches
body: Member observing contract/statute breach must notify Local President or Steward to launch a grievance.

title: Right to Representation
body: No grievor will be denied representation at any time.

title: Constitutional Amendment Threshold
body: Constitution amended only by 2/3 vote of delegates present and voting at Convention.

title: Shop Steward Working Areas
body: Locals define working areas in same building/site. Members in area elect one or more Shop Stewards.

title: Local Executive Committee Composition
body: LEC composed of Shop Stewards. LEC Officers (President, VP, Secretary, Treasurer, Chief Steward) elected from among Stewards at general meeting.

title: Required Local Officers
body: Every Local must have a President and at least 2 of: VP, Secretary, Treasurer/Sec-Treas, plus Chief/Unit Stewards.

title: Local Term of Office (3 Years Default)
body: Term of office for Stewards and Officers elected after Convention 2024 is 3 years, unless Local adopts a bylaw for 1 to 2 years.

title: Secret Ballot Elections
body: All elections within the Union shall be conducted by secret ballot.

title: Local President Duties
body: Enforce bylaws, preside at meetings, ex-officio on committees, generally supervise Local affairs.

title: Local Trustees Audit Committee
body: Every Local elects at least 2 Trustees (audit committee) who cannot hold other Local office. Audit books at least twice yearly and file 6-month reports to HQ.

title: Local Membership Meetings Frequency
body: General membership meetings must be convened at least twice each year.

title: Quorum Requirements Grid
body: 1-20 members = 50%; 21-200 members = 10 members; 201+ members = 5% of members.

title: Steward Oath
body: Mandatory oath promising to uphold Constitution/Bylaws, represent members, and dismantle anti-Black and anti-Indigenous racism.

title: Local Financial Administration
body: Local funds used only for trade union purposes; expenditures by cheque/online with 2 signing officers (President, VP, Sec, Treas, Chief Steward).

title: Strikebreaking Declaration Vote
body: Local membership meeting may declare a member engaged in strikebreaking by 2/3 majority vote after reasonable written notice and opportunity to present views.

title: Essential/Emergency Exemption
body: Members performing designated essential/emergency services during a legal strike are exempt from strikebreaking sanctions.

title: Picket Line Protocol
body: Members shall not violate picket lines and shall not perform bargaining unit work of striking/locked-out members, except as required by law/essential agreement.
